ui:help.en: Numeric id of the Ark account the group is created on. Only accounts with an access key and secret key can hold asset groups; GET /api/v1/p/volcengine/accounts lists the ids.
ui:help.zh: 在哪个方舟账号上创建素材组，填账号的数字 id。只有填了 Access Key / Secret Key 的账号才能用素材库；账号 id 见 GET /api/v1/p/volcengine/accounts。

ui:help.en: The group name sent to Ark. It is not unique upstream, so pick something you will recognize.
ui:help.zh: 发给方舟的素材组名称。上游不要求唯一，请起一个自己能认出来的名字。

ui:help.en: Ark's asset group type. Leave AIGC unless the Volcengine documentation tells you otherwise.
ui:help.zh: 方舟的素材组类型。除非火山文档另有说明，保持 AIGC 即可。
